### Tried to cluster on epi villi only
The low density ones are 1, 4 and 7. 1 and 4 are almost exclusively not si mucosa. Only a single with very low lc are there, 
Then comes 3 and 8 - 
In cluster 1 everything but 1 (with very low lc numbers) is junk (not si)
Cluster 2 has a lot of ie lympgocytes often clustered
Cluster 3 has pretty mid single lc but there are some with low but fp epi and some with a bit higher but fn lc
Cluster 4 is tiny - just two mucosa from one wsi - both are no si from a serosal lymphoma
Cl 5 is pretty big -high ie lc but mostly singles, also definitley contains some with FP epithelials
Cl 6 is pretty scattered, but larger lc? also lenty fp epi


```{r}
library(cluster)
library(factoextra)


villi_epithelium <- robust_features %>% 
  select(image_name:mucosa_name, 
         villi_epithelium_lymphocytes_mean_log_closest_neighbor_um_robust,
         villi_epithelium_lymphocytes_sd_log_closest_neighbor_um_robust,
         villi_epithelium_lymphocytes_pct_cluster_ge_3_robust,
         villi_epithelium_lymphocytes_mean_measured_area_um2_robust,
         villi_epithelium_lymphocytes_sd_measured_area_um2_robust) %>%
  rename(`Dist-mean` = villi_epithelium_lymphocytes_mean_log_closest_neighbor_um_robust,
         `Dist-sd` = villi_epithelium_lymphocytes_sd_log_closest_neighbor_um_robust,
         `Clustered` = villi_epithelium_lymphocytes_pct_cluster_ge_3_robust,
         `Size-mean` = villi_epithelium_lymphocytes_mean_measured_area_um2_robust,
         `Size-sd` = villi_epithelium_lymphocytes_sd_measured_area_um2_robust)

id_cols     <- c("image_name", "fragment_name", "mucosa_name")   # keep, don’t cluster

cluster_vars <- c("Dist-mean",
         "Dist-sd",
         "Clustered",
         "Size-mean",
         "Size-sd")

to_cluster <- villi_epithelium %>%
  select(all_of(cluster_vars)) %>%
  drop_na() 

id_df <- villi_epithelium  %>%
  select(all_of(id_cols)) %>%
  slice(match(rownames(to_cluster), rownames(villi_epithelium )))

#pick k - elbow
fviz_nbclust(to_cluster, kmeans, method = "wss", k.max = 10) +
  labs(title = "Elbow method (already scaled)")

#pick k silhoette
fviz_nbclust(to_cluster, kmeans, method = "silhouette", k.max = 10) +
  labs(title = "Silhouette method")

best_k <- 8

km <- kmeans(to_cluster, centers = best_k, nstart = 25)

villi_epithelium_clustered <- bind_cols(
  id_df,
  to_cluster,
  cluster = factor(km$cluster)
)


# -------------------------------------------------
# 6.  Principal-component analysis (PCA) & visuals
# -------------------------------------------------

# 6a.  Run PCA  ────────────────────────────────────
# If the five features are NOT already scaled to the same unit/variance,
# keep scale.=TRUE, center=TRUE.  Otherwise set both to FALSE.
pca_res <- prcomp(to_cluster,
                  center = TRUE,
                  scale.  = TRUE)

# 6b.  Scree plot – how many PCs matter? ----------
fviz_eig(pca_res, addlabels = TRUE) +         # % variance per PC
  labs(title = "Scree plot (PCA on villus-epithelium features)")

# 6c.  Individuals (points) coloured by k-means cluster -----------
fviz_pca_ind(
  pca_res,
  geom.ind      = "point",
  pointshape    = 21,
  fill.ind      = factor(km$cluster),  # colour by cluster
  col.ind       = "black",
  palette       = "Dark2",
  addEllipses   = TRUE,
  ellipse.level = 0.90,
  repel         = TRUE,                # avoids text overlap
  legend.title  = "Cluster"
) +
  labs(title = paste0("PCA of lymphocyte features (k = ", best_k, ")"))

# 6d.  Variable contribution (optional) ----------
fviz_pca_var(pca_res,
             col.var = "contrib",     # colour by contribution
             gradient.cols = c("#99c1de", "#166ba9", "#08306b"),
             repel = TRUE) +
  labs(title = "Variable loadings on the first two PCs")


```

### Tried to cluster on lp villi only

Cluster 1 is all junk - low count, high dist
Cluster 2 is low cellularity, alot of junk, one with high cellularity LCL but terrible recognition (lp/epi would help - 15B3219_T1T2)
Cluster 3 is high cellularity - definitely some variability
Cluster 4 is low but patchy
Cluster 5 is stabley low

```{r}
library(cluster)
library(factoextra)


villi_lp <- robust_features %>% 
  select(image_name:mucosa_name, 
         villi_lamina_propria_lymphocyte_count_per_1000_um2_robust,
         villi_lamina_propria_lymphocytes_mean_log_closest_neighbor_um_robust) %>%
  rename(`Dist-mean` = villi_lamina_propria_lymphocytes_mean_log_closest_neighbor_um_robust,
         Count = villi_lamina_propria_lymphocyte_count_per_1000_um2_robust) %>%
  mutate(image_fragment_name = paste(image_name, fragment_name, mucosa_name, sep = "_"))

rownames(villi_lp) <- villi_lp$image_fragment_name

villi_lp <- villi_lp %>% select(`Dist-mean`, Count)  %>%
  drop_na() 


#pick k - elbow
fviz_nbclust(villi_lp, kmeans, method = "wss", k.max = 10) +
  labs(title = "Elbow method (already scaled)")

#pick k silhoette
fviz_nbclust(villi_lp, kmeans, method = "silhouette", k.max = 10) +
  labs(title = "Silhouette method")


best_k <- 5

km <- kmeans(to_cluster, centers = best_k, nstart = 25)

villi_lp_clustered <- bind_cols(
  villi_lp,
  cluster = factor(km$cluster)
)


# -------------------------------------------------
# 6.  Principal-component analysis (PCA) & visuals
# -------------------------------------------------

# 6a.  Run PCA  ────────────────────────────────────
# If the five features are NOT already scaled to the same unit/variance,
# keep scale.=TRUE, center=TRUE.  Otherwise set both to FALSE.
pca_res <- prcomp(villi_lp,
                  center = TRUE,
                  scale.  = TRUE)

# 6b.  Scree plot – how many PCs matter? ----------
fviz_eig(pca_res, addlabels = TRUE) +         # % variance per PC
  labs(title = "Scree plot (PCA on villus-epithelium features)")

# 6c.  Individuals (points) coloured by k-means cluster -----------
fviz_pca_ind(
  pca_res,
  geom.ind      = "point",
  pointshape    = 21,
  fill.ind      = factor(km$cluster),  # colour by cluster
  col.ind       = "black",
  palette       = "Dark2",
  addEllipses   = TRUE,
  ellipse.level = 0.90,
  repel         = TRUE,                # avoids text overlap
  legend.title  = "Cluster"
) +
  labs(title = paste0("PCA of lymphocyte features (k = ", best_k, ")"))

# 6d.  Variable contribution (optional) ----------
fviz_pca_var(pca_res,
             col.var = "contrib",     # colour by contribution
             gradient.cols = c("#99c1de", "#166ba9", "#08306b"),
             repel = TRUE) +
  labs(title = "Variable loadings on the first two PCs")


```
### Added lp/epi ratio to lp villi only
#1 is low lc, variable epi/lp
#2 is low low
# is high high

```{r}
library(cluster)
library(factoextra)
```
